== Switches.classic (line 2)
| classic(day)
  case
    | day?
    | 1
    | 2, 3
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | name := "Monday"
    -
      instruction
        | name := "Midweek"
    -
      instruction
        | name := "Other"
  jump
    | return name

== Switches.fallthrough (line 18)
| fallthrough(a)
  instruction
    | r := 0
  case
    | a?
    | 1
    | 2
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | r := r + 1
      instruction
        | r := r + 2
    -
      instruction
        | r := r + 2
    -
      instruction
        | r := -1
  jump
    | return r
! line 21: Fallthrough

== Switches.defaultInMiddle (line 33)
| defaultInMiddle(a)
  case
    | a?
    | 1
    | 2
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | r := 10
    -
      instruction
        | r := 20
    -
      instruction
        | r := 0
  jump
    | return r

== Switches.noDefault (line 49)
| noDefault(a)
  case
    | a?
    | 1
    | 2
    | %
    -
      call
        | work()
    -
      call
        | work()
    -

== Switches.work (line 60)
| work()
